guide.summary: GitLab documents OAuth 2 third-party app registration with an authorization code flow. The read path is GET /projects/:id/issues with an OAuth Bearer token. The documented read_api scope is broader than issues alone, so access is bounded by the connected person's project access. Use only GET requests. Provider review and customer distribution rules are not in the supplied sources and remain unknowns.

findings.title: read_api grants read access to projects the account can reach
findings.detail: read_api provides read access to the API, including all groups and projects. It is the documented read scope for this request. Its real boundary is the connected account's membership.

findings.title: Use the OAuth Bearer header, not PRIVATE-TOKEN examples
